_about: Adjustment parameters for vnrealty/valuation/comps.py (and the haircut used by hedonic.py / calibrate.py). Every parameter carries a `basis` saying whether it is sourced, partly sourced, or judgement, and the ids of the sources behind it. No transaction-level dataset for Đà Nẵng was found: where the press gives only anecdotes or broker rules of thumb, the range here is deliberately conservative (narrower premiums, wider haircut band). Replace with calibrated values from `vnr calibrate` once sale evidence accumulates. Rates are fractions; widths in metres.

cafef_ep_gia_2026.title: Sự thật đằng sau việc người mua ép giá bất động sản (CafeF, 2026-08-20)
cafef_ep_gia_2026.claim: Negotiation happens 'at a moderate level'; one seller cut from about 15B to 12–13B VND to close quickly (≈13–20% off asking, our arithmetic; anecdote, not a statistic).

thuviennhadat_lo_goc.title: Đất lô góc là gì? Lưu ý quan trọng khi mua đất lô góc (thuviennhadat.vn)
thuviennhadat_lo_goc.claim: Corner lots are commonly valued about 10–30% above a single-frontage lot (broker rule of thumb).

wiki_bds_lo_dat.title: Lô đất là gì? (wiki.batdongsan.com.vn, 2022-08-15)
wiki_bds_lo_dat.claim: A corner unit sells for up to ~30% more than the adjoining unit (listing-portal claim).

baophapluat_hem_sau.title: Nhà đất hẻm sâu bị ép giá tiền tỷ (Báo Pháp Luật, doanh nhân)
baophapluat_hem_sau.claim: An expert estimates deep-alley property loses about 60% versus street frontage and is 30–40% below a car-wide alley (HCMC context).

qd46_2016_danang.title: Quyết định 46/2016/QĐ-UBND TP Đà Nẵng (bảng giá đất, superseded)
qd46_2016_danang.claim: Official position classes by kiệt width: VT2 ≥4.5 m, VT3 3–<4.5 m, VT4 1.7–<3 m. Used for the breakpoints of the alley curve.

qd06_2019_danang.title: Quyết định 06/2019/QĐ-UBND TP Đà Nẵng (sửa đổi bảng giá đất)
qd06_2019_danang.claim: An Hải road: 3.5 m section 19,500 vs 5.5 m section 24,440 (thousand VND/m²), a ratio ≈0.80 — one official street, used as a sanity check on the curve's slope.

luatduyhung_giay_tay.title: Mua đất giấy tay, vi bằng: rủi ro và hướng xử lý (Luật Duy Hưng)
luatduyhung_giay_tay.claim: Buyers choose handwritten-paper (giấy tay) deals because they are cheaper, at large legal risk. Qualitative only — no percentage.

asking_to_sale.meaning: sale price ÷ asking price. Applied explicitly to asking comps; sale evidence is never haircut.
asking_to_sale.basis: partly sourced: press anecdotes only (cafef_ep_gia_2026: ~13–20% cuts to close fast, 'moderate' negotiation otherwise). No Đà Nẵng transaction dataset found. Judgement band 5–15% off asking for a soft 2026 market; recalibrate from sale_evidence.

corner_premium.meaning: price/m² multiplier is (1 + value) for a corner lot versus an interior one.
corner_premium.basis: partly sourced: broker/portal rules of thumb say 10–30% (thuviennhadat_lo_goc, wiki_bds_lo_dat). Those are seller-side claims, so the desk keeps a conservative 0–10% with a 5% central until calibrated.

alley_curve.meaning: price/m² relative to street frontage (alley_m = 0) as a function of kiệt width in metres; linear between points, flat beyond the last. The adjustment is curve(subject) / curve(comp).
alley_curve.basis: partly sourced: deep alley ≈ −60% vs frontage and narrow ≈ 30–40% below a car alley (baophapluat_hem_sau, HCMC expert estimate); breakpoints at the official 1.7 / 3 / 4.5 m position classes (qd46_2016_danang); the 3.5→5.5 m slope (0.53→0.65, ratio 0.82) agrees with the An Hải official ratio 0.80 (qd06_2019_danang). The level of each point is judgement. Comps in the same width class largely cancel it.

frontage.meaning: price/m² multiplier 1 + per_m × (frontage − ref_m), clamped to ±cap; adjustment is the subject's multiplier over the comp's.
frontage.basis: judgement: no source found. Small and capped on purpose.

legal.meaning: price/m² multiplier by title status; the adjustment is factor(subject) / factor(comp). 'unknown' is not adjusted (recorded as unknown) — never guessed.
legal.basis: judgement: giấy tay is cheaper for legal risk (luatduyhung_giay_tay, qualitative). No percentage source found; 25% central with a wide 15–40% range. hdmb 5% is judgement.

size.meaning: price/m² scales as area^elasticity: adjustment (subject_area / comp_area)^elasticity. Smaller lots ask more per m².
size.basis: judgement: no source found; mild on purpose and the area band (0.75–1.3×) keeps it under ±3%.
